scope: Cached ontology artifact consistency fence only; input freshness and automatic downstream invalidation remain pending.
verified_invariants: The exact old _run and _complete_stage methods are both included in baseline comparison; current unchanged services are mocked identically.
Tampered ontology, project mismatch, missing registered ontology, and malformed manifest stop in ONTOLOGY before any stage updater entry or downstream work.
Rejected cases preserve project state, ontology bytes or absence, and original manifest bytes, including malformed manifests.
Healthy reuse and late file replacement preserve the original ontology registration instead of restamping it.
Current and shared-owner manifest registrations are checked together against one ontology byte snapshot; an empty child cannot override owner proof.
Conflicting or malformed inherited/current proof is rejected without changing base/child handoff or manifest files.
Invalid registration shape, boolean byte count, nonstring digest, and empty entity_types are rejected.
Legacy project-only absence and explicit validation opt-out remain explicitly unverified compatibility modes.

healthy_guard_cost.note: Local same-fixture guard overhead only. Healthy real_run invokes it twice; excludes paid calls. No production speedup claim.

limits: This is not input freshness or automatic regeneration/invalidation proof.
Healthy local guard timing uses an 82-byte synthetic ontology and warm local storage; it does not establish production latency.
No saved run, production pipeline, provider request, or repository source mutation was executed by the successful review.

invalid_initial_launcher.reason: Copied baseline function globals did not inherit fixture module-name service replacements, causing real-client construction during the baseline path.
invalid_initial_launcher.outcome: Twelve DNS attempts were blocked by the offline guard. The reviewer interrupted only the owned launcher PID; the launcher and observed child have exited. No outbound request succeeded.
invalid_initial_launcher.correction: Rebind exact compiled baseline code to live module globals so fixture service substitutions apply identically; final v3 has zero network events.
